title: Origin story: Thornwhisper
description: Thornwhisper was a hedge-witch's daughter raised in the briar marches, who learned the thorn-tongue before human speech. When the logging barons came with saws, she did not fight them — she negotiated. The resulting Thorn Compact is still law: take only the fallen, plant two for one, and never cut at night.

title: Ability profile: Thornwhisper
description: Ranked abilities: Negotiation — rank 100/100; Thorn-tongue — rank 98/100; Patience — rank 96/100; Botany — rank 95/100; Courage — rank 92/100.

title: Power ranking: Thornwhisper
description: Powers: Thorns grow where she points and hold where she wills; She hears the wild's grievances as speech; No blade cuts what she has warded.

title: Stamina feats: Thornwhisper
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Stood three days in the briar to prove her claim; Negotiated through a whole winter of talks.

title: Crossover notes: Thornwhisper
description: Thornwhisper crosses naturally with: thorns, negotiation, the wild's terms.

title: Design notes: Thornwhisper
description: Diplomacy with teeth; the wild as a party to treaties.
